The invoices other businesses issued to the organisation, served from the organisation’s mirror of the authority gateway’s feed in the token’s mode, narrowed to its own tax ids (`taxpayer.taxIds`). `tier`: `forward` (default), the Received tab: the invoices that reached the organisation on or after it connected its tax id in this mode (`sync.since`); `history`, the History tab: invoices retrieved from the tax authority on request (`POST /i/v1/inbound-invoices/history-runs`), whose `sync` is the newest retrieval’s. operations.description: Requires `invoice.create`; charged as one invoice creation. Creates a draft (`status: draft`); the number is allocated from the series when `invoiceNumber` is omitted. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe: a repeated key answers the first result with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.
Requires `invoice.delete_draft`. Drafts only; the draft is deleted permanently and its number is never reused.

Requires `invoice.read`. One document with its lines. A document of another organisation or of the other mode answers 404 `RES001`, like a missing one. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

Requires `invoice.update_draft`. Drafts only (409 `BIZ201` otherwise). An absent field is unchanged; `null` clears an optional one; `lineItems` replaces every line. `If-Match: "<version>"` is optional; a stale version answers 409 `RES003`. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

operations.summary: Get the tax authority’s copy of an invoice
operations.description: Requires `invoice.download_authority_copy`. The tax authority’s own decrypted copy of a registered document, as JSON. Not charged.

Requires `invoice.cancel`. A finalised invoice the tax authority does not hold (never submitted, rejected, or still queued) is voided locally, free of charge. A registered one is cancelled with a credit note for everything left, charged as one cancellation; it becomes `cancelled` once the credit note registers. A draft is 409 `BIZ201` (delete it instead); a document in flight to the tax authority, a credit note, or one already cancelled is 409 `BIZ004`. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`. Answers the original as it now stands. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

202.description: The original invoice, cancelled or being cancelled.

operations.summary: Issue a credit note against a registered invoice
operations.description: Requires `invoice.cancel`. Credits everything left (`full`), chosen lines and quantities (`lines`), or a tax-inclusive `amount`; several credit notes may be issued as long as their total stays within the payable amount plus any debit notes. Each credit note is charged as one cancellation. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`. With `preview: true` nothing is written or charged and the answer is 200 with the preview.

200.description: With `preview: true`: what would be issued.

202.description: The original invoice as it now stands and the credit note just issued.

operations.summary: Issue a debit note against a registered invoice
operations.description: Requires `invoice.create` and `invoice.submit`. Adds lines to a registered invoice as a debit note and submits it; the charge is held and captured when it registers (released if the tax authority rejects it). Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`. With `preview: true` nothing is written or charged and the answer is 200 with the preview.

200.description: With `preview: true`: what would be issued.

202.description: The original invoice as it now stands and the debit note just issued.

operations.summary: Download an invoice as a PDF
operations.description: Content negotiation on `Accept`: `application/pdf` answers the PDF itself as an attachment; anything else (or no `Accept`) answers a short-lived download link in the JSON envelope. Never cached (`Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `Vary: Accept`).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Only `pdf` exists.

200.description: The PDF (`application/pdf`), or a download link (`application/json`).

operations.description: Requires `invoice.finalise`. Freezes the seller and buyer onto the document; 422 `VAL001` when the jurisdiction’s checks refuse it. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

Requires `invoice.finalise` and `invoice.submit`. When the organisation is connected to NRS and reports automatically, the draft is finalised and submitted (202). Otherwise it is finalised and sent to the buyer without being reported (200, `notReportedReason` says why). Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`.

200.description: Finalised and sent to the buyer, not reported.

operations.description: Requires `invoice.record_payment`. Only for a document registered with the tax authority; the latest report is relayed to it. Not charged. `amountPaidMinor` moves only once the tax authority accepts the report (see `payments`).

operations.summary: Refresh an invoice’s status from the tax authority
operations.description: Requires `invoice.query_status`; charged as one status query before the call and refunded when the tax authority is unavailable (503 `SYS202`, nothing changed) or answers a status this service does not recognise yet (409 `BIZ219`, nothing changed). The answer only ever moves the status forward. A submission the tax authority registered but will not send through its network (the buyer is not on e-invoicing, or B2C) is complete: it reads registered, with its reference and verification code, and `offNetworkReason` says why. An `Idempotency-Key` is bound to this invoice; reusing it for another invoice is 409 `BIZ107`.

operations.summary: Renumber an invoice and resubmit it
operations.description: Requires `invoice.submit`. Only when the current submission is on hold because the tax authority already holds the invoice number: the invoice takes the next number of its series (the old one is kept on the withdrawn submission) and a new submission is queued with a new charge hold. Otherwise 409 `BIZ004` says why. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`; a repeated key answers 200 with `replayed: true`.

200.description: A replay of an earlier request with the same key.

operations.summary: Reopen a finalised invoice as a draft
operations.description: Requires `invoice.reopen`. Allowed while the current submission was rejected by the tax authority, or when the invoice was never submitted (then it is revised: same number, next version). `If-Match` is optional. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

operations.summary: Retry an invoice submission on hold
operations.description: Requires `invoice.retry`. Resumes the same submission that is on hold, with its existing charge hold.

operations.summary: Revise an issued invoice that was never reported
operations.description: Requires `invoice.reopen`. An issued invoice never reported to the tax authority and unpaid goes back to a draft with the same number and the next version; otherwise 409 `BIZ201` says what to do instead. `If-Match` is optional. The `ETag` header carries the invoice `version`.

operations.summary: Send an invoice to its buyer
operations.description: `invoice.send_to_buyer`; charged per send (refunded if it cannot be recorded). Queues an email of a finalised invoice to the buyer email on the issued document (never an address from the request), with an optional `message`. 202 means accepted and queued, not delivered. In sandbox no email leaves: `shareUrl` links to the PDF for preview. A replayed `Idempotency-Key` answers the first result with `replayed: true`.
`invoice.share`. Every link of the invoice, newest first, revoked and expired included (kept 90 days); `url` is always null here.

operations.summary: Create a share link to a finalised invoice
operations.description: `invoice.share`. A random, stored, revocable token; `url` is answered ONCE (only its sha256 is kept). `expiresInSeconds` 3600–2592000 (default 604800), `maxViews` 1–10000 (absent = unlimited). At most 20 live links per invoice. Emits the `invoice.share_link.created` event.

201.description: The link, with its `url` — the one time the token is shown.

operations.description: `invoice.share`. Immediate: the next resolve is 404. Idempotent (a revoked link answers 200 with its view). Emits the `invoice.share_link.revoked` event.
Requires `invoice.read`. The status as last recorded, with every submission; the tax authority is not called and nothing is charged.

operations.summary: Submit an invoice to the tax authority
operations.description: Requires `invoice.submit`. Queues a submission of a finalised invoice; with `finalise=true` a draft is finalised and submitted in one step. Idempotent per invoice: while a submission is in flight the same one is answered with 200 and `replayed: true`. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: finalise
parameters.description: Finalise a draft and submit it in one step.

200.description: A submission already in flight (`replayed: true`).

operations.description: Requires `invoice.submit`. Submits 1 to 100 invoices, each independently (its own charge and outcome); the batch counts once against the rate limit. Per-invoice results say which were queued and which failed.

operations.summary: List previously used HS or service codes
operations.description: `item.read`. `type=goods` reads the lines’ HS codes, `type=service` their service codes, over the organisation’s invoices in the token’s mode, every status (drafts and cancelled count). Most used first, then most recent; `description` is the most recent line’s product category for the code. This reads your own invoices, not the tax authority’s code lists.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: goods → HS codes; service → service codes.

operations.summary: Create an invoice and submit it
operations.description: Requires `invoice.create` and `invoice.submit`. Creates the invoice as `POST /invoices` does, then submits it. When the submit is refused the draft is kept and `submitRefusal` says why. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`.
`reference.read`; free. The HS code list of the organisation’s jurisdiction, in the token’s mode, filtered by `search` and `category`; `page` and `limit`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text in the code, description or category.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Exact category name (case-insensitive).

200.description: One page of HS codes, `meta.pagination` set.

operations.description: `reference.read`; free. The category names of the HS code list of the organisation’s jurisdiction, in the token’s mode, sorted.

`tax_id.lookup`; charged per lookup before the provider is asked, refunded when it could not answer (503, never "not registered"). An `Idempotency-Key` retry is not charged twice; the lookup is made again.

Requires `invoice.stats.read`. Key figures over the last `windowDays` compared with the window before, the daily trend, status and payment distribution, collections, alerts, readiness and the most recent documents.
`reference.read`; free. Every code list of the organisation’s jurisdiction in the token’s mode: type, version, item count, fetch time and staleness.
`reference.read`; free. One code list’s items; a type the jurisdiction does not serve is 404.

operations.summary: Get the reference data for the invoice form
operations.description: Requires `invoice.read`. Currencies, invoice kinds, tax categories with their current rates, unit codes, the tax connection state, and the next invoice number (a preview, not reserved).

Requires `invoice.stats.read`. Over documents created in the window (default the last 30 days, at most 366): counts by status and by payment status, the success rate, totals by currency, and output tax.

Emits the `invoice.item.created` event.

`item.archive`. Hard delete only while no invoice line of this mode’s database references the item (drafts included); otherwise 409 BIZ004 — archive it instead. Answers 200 `{id, deleted: true}`. Emits the `invoice.item.deleted` event.
`item.read`. An archived item is readable by id (`archivedAt` set).

`item.update`. The create fields, all optional; `itemType` is immutable; a `sku` change obeys the unique rule; an archived item is editable but not usable on a line. Lines already built from the item never change. Emits the `invoice.item.updated` event.

`item.archive`. Idempotent (an archived item answers 200 with the same view). An archived item is left out of the item list by default and refused on a new line (409 BIZ004); lines that already carry it are untouched. Emits the `invoice.item.archived` event.
`item.archive`. Idempotent. Refused 409 RES002 when another non-archived item took the sku meanwhile. Emits the `invoice.item.unarchived` event.

connectionState.description: The connection state in this mode (null: no live connection). Received invoices are shown while the organisation has any tax-identity history or a connected grant.

taxIds.description: The organisation’s tax ids in this mode (authority form, deduped, the current connected one first). Empty: nothing is shown.

id.description: The auth user id for `user`, the API-key id for `api_key`; may be null for `service` and `system`.

number.description: The number NRS holds once the linked document is registered; its own number before.

counts.description: False once NRS refused the note (it no longer counts).

closing.description: The credit note that credits the invoice in full.

refundOwedMinor.description: A credit note’s share of the refund owed; null on a debit note. Integer minor units.

channel.description: `nrs`: through the NRS network; `email`: off the network, emailed once registered; `none`: no buyer, or no way to reach them.

taxIdStatus.description: As it stood when the document was finalised (see `buyerVerification` for now).

partyName.description: The buyer’s name on the document, in capitals: the business name NRS holds, else the verified legal name, else the name entered.

tinProblem.description: Present only when the buyer’s TIN could not be used (`format`: malformed; `not_found`): why the document was issued without it.

taxIdVerifiedSource.description: `nrs` (the network lookup) or `tin_check` (the charged check); null unless verified.

state.description: `settled`: nothing was paid, the credit settles the debt; otherwise a refund is owed to the buyer.

refundOwedMinor.description: What the seller owes the buyer back. Integer minor units.

refundedMinor.description: What has been recorded as refunded. Integer minor units.

refundOutstandingMinor.description: `refundOwedMinor − refundedMinor`, never below zero. Integer minor units.

paidOnOriginalMinor.description: What was paid on the original invoice and its debit notes, as the tax authority accepted it: says why nothing is owed back (nothing paid, or less than what is still owed). Integer minor units.

stillOwedMinor.description: What the buyer still owes after every credit note, never below zero. Integer minor units.

number.description: The number NRS holds once the linked document is registered; its own number before.

kind.description: `organisation`: the organisation’s own connected tax identity; `test_entity`: the sandbox test taxpayer.

taxId.description: The tax id the document was issued under.

serviceId.description: The service id the tax authority gave the issuer, when there is one.

itemId.description: A saved item of the organisation: every field of the line left out is filled from the item, and a field sent wins.

isicCode.description: ISIC code (services); stored as the service code.

serviceCategory.description: The ISIC description (services). Stored as the line’s product category; send it or productCategory, not both.

unitCode.description: A unit code of the jurisdiction’s list. Required without an itemId.

unitPrice.description: Major units, decimal string (≤ 4 decimals) or number; ≥ 0. Required without an itemId.

taxCategory.description: A tax-category code-list id, or a short alias (standard | zero | exempt). Required without an itemId.

itemId.description: The saved item the line was filled from.

creditedQuantity.description: On an invoice: the quantity credit notes have credited (what is left is `quantity − creditedQuantity`). Null on a note.

creditsLineNo.description: On a credit-note line: the original invoice’s line it credits; null on an amount credit and elsewhere.

needsAttention.description: Rejected or on hold, not cancelled.

outstanding.description: Per currency: what buyers still owe on issued invoices, net of credit notes.

overdue.description: Per currency: the part of `outstanding` past its due date.

amountPaidMinor.description: The cumulative amount paid this report stands for; null for `unpaid` and `payment_failed`. Integer minor units.

installmentMinor.description: What was actually sent to the tax authority; null when nothing was sent. Integer minor units.

authorityStatus.description: The status the tax authority was sent; null while pending or when superseded.

state.description: How the document stands with the tax authority.

delivery.description: How the buyer gets the document.

reason.description: Why the document is delivered the way it is, when that needs saying.

nextAction.description: What the seller can do next (renumber and resubmit, or retry), when anything.

partyName.description: The seller’s name on the document, in capitals: the business name NRS holds when connected, else the verified legal name, else the name entered.

reportAutomatically.description: Whether every invoice issued while connected to NRS is reported automatically.

version.description: 0 while the settings were never changed; send it back as `If-Match` (also the `ETag`).

updatedAt.description: Null while the settings were never changed.

nextInvoiceNumber.description: The next number the series would allocate (a preview, not reserved).

state.description: The organisation’s tax connection in this mode (always `connected` in sandbox).

successRate.description: Percent with one decimal: registered (or later) over submitted; 0 when nothing was submitted.

outputTax.description: Per currency: tax of registered invoices issued in the window less that of registered credit notes.

lineExtensionMinor.description: Σ line nets. Integer minor units.

payableMinor.description: The amount payable. Integer minor units.

payload.description: The verification payload persisted when the document registered.

invoiceNumber.description: The document’s own number, unique per organisation.

authorityInvoiceNumber.description: The number NRS holds, once registered; null until then.

parkReason.description: Why the current submission is on hold.

issuedAs.description: The identity the document was issued under; null until its first submission.

seller.description: A draft shows the seller as it is now; a finalised document as it was when finalised.

buyer.description: A draft shows the buyer as it is now; a finalised document as it was when finalised.

buyerVerification.description: The buyer’s verification as it stands now; null with no buyer or tax id, or once the buyer’s tax id differs from the document’s.

lineItems.description: The lines. Absent on list items.

paymentStatus.description: What the buyer paid (on a credit note: its refund status). Never moved by a cancellation.

amountPaidMinor.description: What the tax authority accepted as paid. Integer minor units.

creditedMinor.description: On an invoice: Σ its counting credit notes (0 when none). Null on a note. Integer minor units.

debitedMinor.description: On an invoice: Σ its counting debit notes (0 when none). Null on a note. Integer minor units.

netReceivableMinor.description: On an invoice: payable + debited − credited, never below zero (also what can still be credited). Null on a note. Integer minor units.

creditStatus.description: On an invoice; null on a note.

adjustments.description: An invoice’s credit and debit notes, in issue order (empty on a note).

creditNoteSettlement.description: On an invoice with a counting credit note, or on a credit note: settled, or a refund owed. Null otherwise.

refundOwedMinor.description: `creditNoteSettlement.refundOwedMinor`, or null with it. Integer minor units.

paymentCeilingMinor.description: What "paid in full" records on this document: an invoice, its payable less its credit notes (debit notes are paid on themselves); a credit note, its share of the refund owed; a debit note, its payable. Integer minor units.

simpleStatus.description: The one status a person reads. `delivered` only when the tax authority says the buyer received it; `transmitted` when it was sent to the buyer's access point and not yet acknowledged.

reportedToNrs.description: The tax authority registered the document; false on a draft.

refundOwed.description: A refund to the buyer is still owed (`refundOwedMinor > 0`).

creditNoteOf.description: A credit note: the invoice it credits.

credits.description: A credit note: the invoice it credits (same as `creditNoteOf`).

debits.description: A debit note: the invoice it increases.

cancelledByCreditNote.description: A cancelled (or being cancelled) invoice: its credit note.

submissionDueAt.description: When a document issued without a buyer tax id (B2C) and not yet submitted must be submitted to the tax authority by: `finalisedAt` plus the jurisdiction window (24 hours in Nigeria). Null when it is signed, being submitted, a draft, cancelled, or of another kind.

submittedBy.description: Who submitted it to the tax authority; null while never submitted.

version.description: The concurrency token: send it back as `If-Match: "<version>"` (also the `ETag`).

submission.description: The queued submission when the invoice is being reported; null otherwise.

reporting.description: `queued`: being reported; `not_reported`: finalised and sent, not reported.

notReportedReason.description: Why the invoice was not reported; null when it was queued.

sentToBuyer.description: Whether the document was emailed to the buyer.

replayed.description: True when the answer replays an earlier request with the same key.

amountMinor.description: mode 'amount' only (required there): the TAX-INCLUSIVE amount, minor units

lineNo.description: mode 'amount' only: the original line whose text, codes and VAT the credit line takes (default 1)

preview.description: true: answer what would be issued; nothing is written or charged
true: answer what would be issued; nothing is written or charged

unitPriceMinor.description: Minor units as a decimal string.

taxCategory.description: Stored resolved to the code-list id.

useCount.description: Finalised invoice lines built from this item.

referenced.description: Whether any invoice line, drafts included, references the item — while true, the item cannot be deleted (archive it instead).

invoicesTaxMinor.description: Tax of the registered invoices. Integer minor units.

creditNotesTaxMinor.description: Tax of the registered credit notes. Integer minor units.

netTaxMinor.description: Invoices’ tax less credit notes’ tax; negative when credits exceed sales. Integer minor units.

deltaPp.description: Change on the previous window, percentage points.

deltaPct.description: Percent change on the previous window.

lga.description: Local government area; left out when not recorded.

overdue.description: Overlaps the others: due before today and not paid.

status.description: unpaid is local only (refused once anything was reported); payment_failed follows an accepted part or full payment.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units; required for partially_paid: the TOTAL received to date (cumulative), not the installment.

certificateFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the retired certificate, hex.

additionalSellersAvailable.description: Always false: the organisation is the only seller.

kind.description: The organisation is its own seller.

taxIdStatus.description: The organisation’s TIN verification status, as recorded in organisation settings.

partyName.description: The name the seller appears under on its documents and to the tax authority, upper case: the tax authority’s business name while the tax connection is connected, else the verified legal name, else `name`.

shareUrl.description: Sandbox only (no email leaves): a presigned link to the PDF for preview.

id.description: The user or key id; null for the system.

url.description: The full link — on the create answer ONLY (the token exists once); null elsewhere.

state.description: The state of the submission’s charge.

field.description: The field the authority named, when it named one.

parkReason.description: Why the submission is on hold.

issuedAs.description: The identity this submission went out under.

verification.description: The verification artefact’s capture; null when there is none.

authorityNote.description: A plain-language note while the submission has waited long for the tax authority to confirm delivery; null otherwise.

authorityLastCheckedAt.description: When the tax authority was last asked.

authorityNextCheckAt.description: When it will next be asked; null when it will not.

offNetworkReason.description: Set when the tax authority registered this submission (reference and verification code issued) and will not send it through its network, because the buyer cannot receive there: `buyer_off_network` (the buyer is not on e-invoicing), `b2c` or `no_buyer_tin` (no buyer tax id). The submission is complete and reported; deliver the invoice to the buyer by email, link or PDF. Null otherwise.

deliveredOffNetworkAt.description: When the tax authority settled the submission off its network; null otherwise.

replayed.description: True when the answer is a submission already in flight.

reference.description: The provider’s verification reference, when verified.

verifiable.description: Whether a tax id of this type can be verified.

taxId.description: In the form the tax authority displays it.

us.description: A submission of ours registered this IRN: Yona was the access point.

provider.description: The other access point, when NRS named it; null for ours, and where NRS did not say (history rows today).

label.description: `Yona`, the provider’s name, or `Another provider` when it is not us and NRS did not say who.

reference.description: NRS’s reference for the access point (`app_reference`): a slug, not an id; NRS offers no lookup to a name.

invoiceNumber.description: A document number of this organisation, mode and issue year (channel, seller code, two-digit year, 6 or more digits).

itemType.description: Immutable: only the stored value is accepted.

description.description: The most recent line’s product category for this code.

useCount.description: Invoice lines carrying the code, in every status (drafts and cancelled included).

sellerId.description: Only the organisation’s own seller id.

invoiceType.description: Only `standard`: credit notes are not validated here.

invoiceDate.description: The issue date (required with an invoice body).

itemId.description: A saved item of the organisation: every omitted field below is filled from it.

unitPrice.description: ≥ 0, ≤ 4 decimals, major units. Required without an itemId.

previewAuthorityReference.description: The reference the authority WOULD mint — a preview, nothing is registered.

totalPages.description: `ceil(total / pageSize)`; an empty set is 0 pages.

message.description: Copy for humans. Never branch on it.

requestId.description: This service’s request id (also the `x-request-id` header) — quote it in a bug report.

endpointId.description: One of the organisation’s endpoints in the caller’s mode.

type.description: Send a sample event of this type; when absent, a `webhook_endpoint.pinged` ping is sent.

resolvedTypes.description: The catalogue types the patterns deliver today, under the capabilities of the member who wrote them.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until when requests also carry a signature for the previous secret.

subscribable.description: Whether the caller holds the capability the type needs.
